import unittest
from archive import pack

class ArchiveTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_compressed_shape(self):
        result = pack(b'a' * 1000)
        self.assertEqual(result['codec'], 'gzip')
        self.assertTrue(result['payload'].startswith(b'\x1f\x8b'))
        self.assertLess(len(result['payload']), 1000)
